events.text: A dark-haired monkey stumbles upon Macaque in the jungle and reports Wukong scouring the mountain, killing and torturing dark-haired monkeys while demanding information about "the demon that calls itself king" and "my imbecile son"

Wukong scours the mountain, killing and torturing dark-haired monkeys and interrogating them about where "the demon that calls itself king" and "my imbecile son" are hiding (scene written from Wukong's POV)
